fintech-scenarios__1.hintEasy: Render-bypass через ref + textContent. Виртуализация. Server-side filtering на видимое.
fintech-scenarios__1.hintFull: Не делать setState на каждый tick. Buffer + rAF flush. Высокочастотные cells через ref. React не должен ребилдить.
fintech-scenarios__1.answer: На fintech-UI цена меняется десятки раз в секунду. Подход: 1) Render-bypass для high-freq cells — компонент монтируется один раз, держит ref на DOM-узел; на новый tick прямой write ref.current.textContent = newPrice + CSS-класс flash для подсветки. React не рендерится. 2) Если нужен React-render — батчинг: накапливать tick-и в Map<symbol, latest>, раз в animation frame через requestAnimationFrame один setState с batch-обновлением. 3) Server-side filtering — пользователь не должен получать ticks для невидимых символов. 4) Виртуализация для market watch / order book. 5) startTransition вокруг тяжёлых non-critical updates. Это используется в Bloomberg, Binance, Interactive Brokers UI. Production-trick — два слоя: React-level state (один раз в секунду) для overall UI, ref-bypass для actual-tick-cells. RUM-metric: latency от tick прихода до paint.

fintech-scenarios__2.hintEasy: Last-known-value с timestamp, stale-detection threshold, visual indicator.
fintech-scenarios__2.hintFull: Хранить timestamp последнего обновления. Если now - lastUpdate > threshold → stale-state. Visual marker.
fintech-scenarios__2.answer: Многослойная защита. 1) Last Known Value (LKV) store: Map<symbol, {value, timestamp}>. UI показывает LKV всегда — не пустота. 2) Stale-detection: раз в секунду проверяем разницу now - timestamp; если > threshold (5с для биржи), помечаем как stale в state. 3) Visual indicator: серый цвет вместо обычного, иконка 'устарело', timestamp 'обновлено N сек назад'. 4) Action-blocking: для critical-actions (place order по цене) — disable button если stale; tooltip 'Wait for fresh data'. 5) Connection indicator в header: green/yellow/red. 6) Sequence-numbers / version в каждом message — если incoming version <= lastApplied → отбросить (race condition / out-of-order). 7) RUM-метрика staleness ratio (% of session with stale-data) — alert при росте. Это критично для trading: устаревшая цена = потенциальный убыток пользователя.

fintech-scenarios__3.hintFull: Visual demphasis (opacity, color), explicit indicator (icon + tooltip), показать last-update-time, replace flash-эффект.
fintech-scenarios__3.answer: Visual encoding для stale data. 1) Color: основной (зелёный/красный для роста/падения) → серый или dimmed (50% opacity). Сразу видно, что данные не текущие. 2) Icon: pause-icon или 'stale'-badge на cell с tooltip 'Data delayed by N seconds'. 3) Timestamp: 'Last updated 12s ago' рядом с value, обновляется live. 4) Disable interactions: hover-tooltip и click-actions на stale-cells могут быть disabled или с warning. 5) Aria-live announcement: SR-юзер должен знать ('Market data delayed'). 6) Connection-indicator в header: явный red icon + текст 'Disconnected, reconnecting...'. 7) For critical-actions — modal warning 'Data not current, do not trade'. 8) После recover — flash-effect 'green' для подтверждения свежести. Inspirations — Trading View, Bloomberg Terminal — они делают stale visualization очень explicit.

fintech-scenarios__4.hintEasy: Heartbeat detection, visual indicator, fallback degraded mode.
fintech-scenarios__4.hintFull: Heartbeat ping/pong каждые N сек. Нет ответа → mark connection stale. UI degraded mode: show LKV + warning.
fintech-scenarios__4.answer: Strategy для real-time feed delays. 1) Heartbeat: ping/pong каждые 30 секунд. Server отвечает pong; нет ответа в 10 секунд → connection stale. 2) Stale-detection: timestamp последнего message; если > threshold → mark connection как degraded. 3) Visual indicator: connection-status в header (green/yellow/red), live updates. 4) Degraded mode UX: continue showing LKV с stale-marker; disable critical-actions; show banner 'Connection slow, reconnecting'. 5) Auto-reconnect: forced disconnect + reconnect с exponential backoff. 6) Snapshot+delta protocol: при reconnect получаем snapshot, не lost ticks. 7) RUM-метрики: reconnect-rate, latency-distribution, stale-ratio per session. Alert на spikes. 8) Multiple feed-providers: fallback на secondary feed при primary degradation. Production-нюанс — explicit user-communication 'Latency: 250ms' в трейдинговом UI помогает пользователю принимать informed decisions.

fintech-scenarios__5.hintEasy: Логировать все user-actions через analytics с timestamp, user, before/after state.
fintech-scenarios__5.hintFull: Каждое critical-action генерит audit-event: что, кто, когда, before/after. Server-side persisted, immutable.
fintech-scenarios__5.answer: Auditability требует тщательной telemetry. 1) Каждое user-action в trading-flow генерирует audit-event: {action: 'place_order', userId, orderDetails, timestamp, sessionId, ip, userAgent}. 2) Frontend captures intent (что юзер планировал — клики, формы, confirmations); server-side captures execution (что реально произошло). 3) Client-side analytics — best-effort (could miss events at network failure); server-side logs — source of truth. 4) Mutation-events: before/after state, чтобы restore-возможность была. 5) Session-replay (LogRocket, FullStory) для critical-flows — позволяет recreate visual context. 6) PII scrubbing — no card numbers, etc., только references. 7) Compliance: SOX, MiFID II требуют hold logs N years. 8) Frontend doesn't trust local clock — timestamps server-set. 9) Cryptographic verification: signed audit-trail с cumulative hash chain (blockchain-style) для tamper-detection. На интервью — emphasis на defence-in-depth и server-side как source of truth.

fintech-scenarios__6.hintEasy: Никогда не логировать card numbers, full account, private balances, transaction details.
fintech-scenarios__6.hintFull: Sentry beforeSend scrubs sensitive fields. Server-side scrub-rules как safety net. References (id) instead of values.
fintech-scenarios__6.answer: Strict rules для sensitive financial data. NEVER log: card numbers (PCI-DSS violation, гигантские штрафы), CVV, full account numbers, balances, transaction amounts, KYC documents (ID numbers, SSN), passwords, tokens, MFA codes. Implementation: 1) Sentry beforeSend hook scrubs predefined fields recursively from request body, breadcrumbs, local-vars. 2) Server-side scrubbing rules в Sentry/Datadog как защита. 3) Logger-wrapper, который проверяет regex-patterns (credit-card, SSN-format) и redacts. 4) Use references not values: log 'orderId: abc123', not amount/account. 5) Code-review checklist обязательно про sensitive-logging. 6) Periodic audit sample-events — open random events, check для sensitive content. 7) Compliance training для команды. 8) Penalty in PR — strict policy 'sensitive in log = revert immediately'. На интервью — упомянуть GDPR, CCPA, PCI-DSS specific rules; legal exposure огромен (штрафы в millions).

fintech-scenarios__7.hintEasy: Confirmation-dialog с явными deталями + idempotency-key + server-side validation.
fintech-scenarios__7.hintFull: Двухэтапный submit: form → confirm dialog (показать all details) → execute. Idempotency-key для retry-safety.
fintech-scenarios__7.answer: Trading form security. 1) Two-step submit: после fill-form — confirmation-dialog показывает all details (symbol, side, quantity, price, total, fees), explicit confirm-button. Не allow accidental click. 2) Idempotency-key: UUID generated на confirm-stage, sent в Idempotency-Key header. Server validates: первый request — execute and store {key → response}; повтор с тем же key — return stored response, no double-execute. 3) Stale-data check: если quote stale, disable submit + show 'wait for fresh data'. 4) Server-side validation обязательно: balance, permission, market-hours, risk-limits. Frontend только UX-side. 5) Rate-limiting на server для protection от flood. 6) MFA для high-value orders. 7) Audit-log каждого attempt (success or fail). 8) Read-back: confirmation-screen после execute показывает что на самом деле было исполнено. 9) Cancel-window: short period после submit, юзер может отменить. Inspirations — Stripe Checkout, Coinbase order flow.

fintech-scenarios__8.hintEasy: Disabled submit во время mutation + idempotency-key на server.
fintech-scenarios__8.hintFull: Frontend: disable + spinner на submit. Backend: idempotency-key cache 24h.
fintech-scenarios__8.answer: Двухслойная защита. 1) Frontend: на submit-click setSubmitting(true), button disabled, повторный click игнорируется. RHF делает это автоматически через formState.isSubmitting. Дополнительно — debounce/throttle на onClick (300мс buffer). 2) Backend (главное): idempotency-key paтtern from Stripe. Frontend генерирует UUID на старте submit (не на каждый retry — один UUID на logical operation). Sent в Idempotency-Key header. Server: первый request — execute, save {key → response} с TTL 24 часа. Повтор с тем же key (e.g., from auto-retry after timeout) — return cached response, no double-execute. 3) Visual feedback: clear status (Processing... → Success/Failed), no ambiguity. 4) After success — clear form или disable refill (no accidental re-submit). 5) Network errors — retry с тем же idempotency-key, не новый. 6) Audit-log fingerprint detection: if тот же user сделал 5 attempts в 1 минуту → alert/throttle. Frontend-only (без idempotency-key) — недостаточно: network retry с broken UI exposes.

fintech-scenarios__9.hintEasy: Optimistic in-flight state с visual indicator, server-confirmation overrides.
fintech-scenarios__9.hintFull: На submit — optimistic UI 'order pending' с spinner. WS push update от server — actual status. Reconciliation.
fintech-scenarios__9.answer: Pending transaction UX. 1) Optimistic state: на submit, добавляем в локальный state {id, status: 'pending', ...} — UI сразу показывает в списке с pending-indicator. 2) Visual: spinner + 'Processing' badge на row, dimmed appearance. 3) Server confirmation через WS: receive {id, status: 'filled' | 'cancelled' | 'failed'} — update локального state. Optimistic state replaced authoritative. 4) Reconciliation: при reconnect получаем actual state от server, override любые stale optimistic-records. 5) Timeout: если не получили confirmation в N секунд — show warning 'Status uncertain, refresh'. 6) Cancel-action: while pending, allow cancel (server-side validates feasibility). 7) Audit/logs: capture timeline (submitted → pending → filled). 8) Pending-orders в URL/state — F5-survival. 9) Toast-notifications на status changes (filled, partial fill, rejected). На интервью — emphasis: never lie to user about state; pending is honest.

fintech-scenarios__10.hintEasy: Idempotency-key generated once per logical operation, retried with same key.
fintech-scenarios__10.hintFull: UUID на старте action (not retry). Сохраняется до success или explicit cancel. Server caches response.
fintech-scenarios__10.answer: Idempotent frontend flow design. 1) Generate idempotency-key один раз на start logical operation: UUID при open form / start checkout / click 'place order' — не на каждый retry. Stored в form-state. 2) All retries (network failure, timeout, manual retry) used same key. 3) Server side: first request executes and stores {key → response} с TTL 24h. Subsequent requests с тем же key return cached response without re-executing. 4) Reset key only after explicit success or user-cancel. 5) Persist key в localStorage / IndexedDB до success — surviving page reload. 6) Different operations get different keys: place_order, cancel_order — separate. 7) Errors classification: 4xx client errors не retry (validation failure won't succeed); 5xx и network errors — retry с same key. 8) Audit-log: каждое attempt с key для traceability. Production source — Stripe API design. 9) Frontend wrapper: useIdempotentMutation hook auto-генерирует key, retries appropriately.

fintech-scenarios__11.hintEasy: Server is source of truth — frontend reconciles периодически.
fintech-scenarios__11.hintFull: Period sync с server — get authoritative state, override optimistic. Show inconsistency warnings if applicable.
fintech-scenarios__11.answer: Inconsistency between client и server is inevitable in distributed systems. Strategy. 1) Server is source of truth — frontend reconciles periodically (refetch active orders каждые 30 секунд, plus on focus / reconnect). 2) Optimistic state — short-lived, replaced authoritative as soon as confirmed. 3) Reconciliation logic: server returns version-numbers / timestamps; client compares lastApplied vs server-version, applies updates. 4) Конфликт detection: optimistic-state shows 'pending', server returns different actual state — show banner 'Status mismatch, refreshing data'. 5) Cross-tab sync: BroadcastChannel — один tab updated state, other tabs see immediately. 6) Versioning: each entity has version-counter; mutations require expected-version (optimistic concurrency control). 7) UX honesty: don't lie — if state uncertain, show 'updating...' instead of guessing. 8) Audit-log all mismatches — investigation tool. 9) Real-time push (WS) — sub-second consistency. На fintech-интервью — emphasis: trust-but-verify, never assume client is right.

fintech-scenarios__12.hintEasy: Permissions model + multi-step approval для high-value + audit log.
fintech-scenarios__12.hintFull: Не roles, а actions с context (order.create up to $1k). MFA для sensitive. Approval workflow для cross-threshold.
fintech-scenarios__12.answer: Role-based access для финансовых операций. 1) Permissions are actions с context, not roles: 'order.create.up_to_1000', 'order.create.up_to_100000', 'admin.user.disable'. Backend reqirement — server-side check on every action. 2) Multi-step approval для high-value: amount > threshold → request second approval from manager. Workflow: pending → approved → executed. 3) MFA для sensitive operations: re-prompt password, или 2FA-code на critical actions even if logged in. Step-up authentication. 4) Time-based restrictions: trading-window enforcement, market hours. 5) Geographic / IP-based limits: high-value transactions only from trusted IPs / devices. 6) Audit log: каждое action with full context (who, what, when, before, after, ip). 7) Cooling-off period: новый device — N hours wait before high-value actions. 8) Frontend UI hides denied actions for UX, but never relies — server-side validates everything. 9) Compliance — SOX, GDPR, MiFID II for EU. На интервью — emphasis on defence-in-depth: layers, не single check.

fintech-scenarios__13.hintEasy: Feature flag с UI-toggle для instant disable. No redeploy.
fintech-scenarios__13.hintFull: Kill-switch flag wraps risky feature. Live-update через WS. Operator turns off в UI in seconds. Replicate production scenarios.
fintech-scenarios__13.answer: Kill-switch design для high-risk feature. 1) Wrap feature in feature flag: <Feature flag='new-trading-flow' fallback={<OldFlow />}><NewFlow /></Feature>. 2) Flag service supports live-update: WS push or short polling (30 sec). User flip switches off — clients see в seconds. 3) UI for operations team: clear list of flags, status, audit-log of changes, requires permissions to flip. 4) Default position: critical flags default-off; turning on is conscious decision. 5) Multiple kill-switches: granular per sub-feature, not single mega-switch. 6) Testing: regular drill — flip flag in staging, verify UX, time-to-take-effect. 7) Communication: when flipped during incident, banner на UI 'Trading temporarily limited' explains user. 8) Audit-log: who flipped, when, why (linked to incident). 9) Auto-flip on metrics: error-rate > X% → auto-disable feature. 10) Removal-plan: flags don't live forever; remove after stable rollout (typical 4 weeks). Inspiration — LaunchDarkly, GrowthBook Kill-switch patterns.

fintech-scenarios__14.hintEasy: Synthetic test environment, paper-trading mode, replay real ticks, internal beta.
fintech-scenarios__14.hintFull: Staging mirrors production data feed. Paper-trading mode (no real money). Replay-tool для historical data. Internal beta period.
fintech-scenarios__14.answer: Multi-stage testing для high-risk UI. 1) Staging mirrors production: same data feeds, same APIs (mocked or sandbox), volume similar. 2) Paper-trading mode: real UI, real flow, but order — sandbox account; user can experiment without risk. 3) Replay-tool: capture historical tick-stream, replay в test environment — verify UI handles real volatility, not synthetic data. 4) Chaos engineering: simulate network failures, slow API, partial outage; UI degrades gracefully, no crash. 5) Internal beta: employees use feature for N weeks before public; team monitors closely. 6) Canary release: 1% → 5% → 25% → 100% с monitoring metric pages, auto-rollback if degradation. 7) Dark-launch: deploy code, run shadow на small % traffic without showing UI — measure backend impact. 8) Performance under load: simulate 10x peak throughput. 9) Security pen-test before launch. 10) Compliance review obligatory для regulated changes (KYC, AML). Documented runbook for incident response. На интервью — emphasis на multi-layer testing: lab + staged + real users.

fintech-scenarios__15.hintEasy: Watch errors-rate, latency, stale-data, conversion. Page on-call для anomaly.
fintech-scenarios__15.hintFull: Critical metrics dashboard. Alerts на degradation. 30-min monitoring window after release. Auto-rollback on critical.
fintech-scenarios__15.answer: Post-release monitoring для trading-фичи. 1) Critical metrics watched in real-time: error-rate per session, latency tick→render, WebSocket reconnect-rate, stale-data ratio, order-success-rate, conversion на key flow. 2) Alerts на anomaly: метрики > threshold (например, error-rate > 2x baseline) → page on-call immediately. 3) Monitoring window: 30-60 минут active watch immediately after release; release annotation на dashboards. 4) Auto-rollback на critical degradation: pre-defined rules (latency > X for Y minutes → revert deployment). 5) Synthetic monitoring: scheduled bots prove main flows работают (place small test order каждые 5 минут). 6) Real User Monitoring (RUM) breakdown: per geography, browser, device — catches segment-specific bugs. 7) Business metrics correlate с tech: orders-per-minute drop after release → investigate. 8) On-call rotation: dedicated engineer для first hours после high-risk deploy. 9) Status page communication: pro-active update users on issues. 10) Postmortem: blameless analysis after any incident, document learning. На интервью — full coverage: tech + business + comms.

fintech-scenarios__16.hintEasy: Read from cache, disable mutations, show last-known-state, escalate to human.
fintech-scenarios__16.hintFull: Backend down — read-only mode (cache), disable trading actions. Visual banner. Auto-recover when back.
fintech-scenarios__16.answer: Graceful degradation strategy. 1) Read-only mode при backend issues: cached data displayed, mutations disabled or queued. 2) Visual banner: 'Service temporarily limited, viewing only' с explanation и ETA if available. 3) Disable critical actions: no new orders, no withdrawals; only view-history allowed. 4) Queue non-critical mutations (Background Sync API): fire when service restored; user sees 'pending sync' indicator. 5) Per-feature degradation: одно зависимое отвалилось не валит всё. Example: chart service down → show 'chart unavailable', table data still works. 6) Health-check polling: client periodically checks; auto-recover when service back. 7) Status-page reference: 'View status at status.app.com' — direction k authoritative info. 8) Escalation: link to support if blocked from critical action. 9) Logging: capture которые юзеры были affected (для post-incident analysis). 10) Communication: tone — apologetic but reassuring; never silently fail. Inspirations — Robinhood (frequent outages, bad comms learning); modern fintechs use status-pages aggressively.

fintech-scenarios__17.hintEasy: Honest banner with affected services, ETA if known, link to status page.
fintech-scenarios__17.hintFull: Specific affected functionality, current state ('viewing only'), tentative ETA, link к full status, regular updates.
fintech-scenarios__17.answer: User communication during partial outage. 1) Banner с specific information: 'Order placement temporarily unavailable due to maintenance' — not generic 'something wrong'. Specific affected functionality. 2) Current state explanation: 'You can view positions and history, but cannot place new orders'. 3) ETA if known: 'Expected resolution by 14:30 UTC' — даже approximate ETA снижает frustration. 4) Link к full status page: 'View detailed status at status.app.com'. 5) Regular updates: every 15-30 минут даже если ничего нового — 'still investigating, ETA updated'. 6) Tone: apologetic but reassuring, professional. 7) Distinct visual: persistent banner top of screen, не toast (миссайбл). 8) Disabled UI elements: clearly disabled state с tooltip explaining why ('Trading paused due to outage'). 9) After resolution: 'service restored' confirmation, allow retry of pending operations. 10) Compensation if applicable: free trades, credits — depends on impact. Avoid: silent failures, blaming users, vague 'try again later'. Inspirations — Cloudflare status comms, Stripe status page.

fintech-scenarios__18.hintEasy: Decimal или string, never floating-point. Library decimal.js или big.js.
fintech-scenarios__18.hintFull: JS Number — IEEE 754 double, lose precision на decimals (0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3). Use decimal.js / big.js / Intl.
fintech-scenarios__18.answer: Money handling в JS. 1) Never use floating-point Number для arithmetic — IEEE 754 doubles lose precision (0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004). На financial UI это catastrophic — pennies disappear or appear. 2) Use Decimal-libraries: decimal.js, big.js, bignumber.js. const total = new Decimal('99.99').plus('0.01'); // exactly 100. Server-side same — Java BigDecimal, Python Decimal, etc. 3) Or: integers in cents — 9999 instead of 99.99. Multiply by 100 on input, divide on output. Common в backend, less convenient on frontend. 4) Display rounding: Intl.NumberFormat с consistent settings ({ minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }). Different for currencies (BTC — 8 digits, JPY — 0 digits). 5) Currency-specific rules: rounding behavior (half-even, half-up), display format (USD $1,234.56, EUR 1.234,56 €). 6) String storage в state: avoid premature conversion to Number; pass strings until display. 7) Tests: include precision-edge-cases, currency-specific. На интервью — emphasis: floating-point money = inevitable bug, no exceptions.

fintech-scenarios__19.hintEasy: Test edge-cases: round-up/down, zero, negative, currency-specific rules.
fintech-scenarios__19.hintFull: Test-cases: 0, very small (0.01), very large, negative, currency-specific rounding, locale-specific format.
fintech-scenarios__19.answer: Currency formatting tests. 1) Edge-cases: 0 (display '$0.00' or '$0' depending on convention), very small (0.001 — round to 0.00 or show as '< $0.01'), very large (precision still preserved), negative (-$5.00 vs ($5.00) accounting style). 2) Currency-specific rules: USD/EUR — 2 decimals; JPY — 0 decimals; BTC — 8 decimals; KWD — 3 decimals. Tests cover each currency правильно. 3) Locale-specific format: en-US '$1,234.56', de-DE '1.234,56 €', fr-FR '1 234,56 €' — separator and position different. Use Intl.NumberFormat instead of manual concat. 4) Rounding behavior: half-even (banker's, default in finance), half-up — consistent выбор тестируется. 5) Number-input parsing: '1,234.56' (US) vs '1.234,56' (EU) — bidirectional consistency. 6) Property-based testing: random values, verify roundtrip (parse → format → parse — same). 7) Visual regression: snapshot tests с different locales. 8) Accessibility: aria-label с full readout ('one thousand two hundred thirty four dollars and fifty six cents') для SR. На интервью — currency-formatting often skipped, demonstrate awareness.

fintech-scenarios__20.hintEasy: Server timestamps в UTC ISO. Frontend converts к local. Display TZ explicitly.
fintech-scenarios__20.hintFull: Backend stores UTC. Frontend formats in user-TZ via Intl.DateTimeFormat. Show TZ-abbrev or full name.
fintech-scenarios__20.answer: Timezone handling в financial data. 1) Server stores all timestamps в UTC, ISO 8601 format ('2026-05-15T14:30:00Z'). Single source of truth. 2) Frontend converts к user-TZ для display: const display = new Date(serverDate).toLocaleString(userLocale, { timeZone: userTZ }). 3) Display TZ explicitly: 'May 15, 2026, 4:30 PM EDT' — пользователь знает which timezone. Не оставлять ambiguous. 4) Trading session times — exchange-specific TZ: 'NYSE: 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET' regardless of user-TZ. Show both: ET и user-TZ. 5) DST transitions: tricky! '2026-03-09 02:30 ET' doesn't exist (DST jump). Use libraries (date-fns-tz, luxon) for safe handling. 6) Aggregated data (daily candles, weekly): aggregation TZ может differ from display TZ — be explicit ('volume by exchange day' vs 'by user day'). 7) User-preference: TZ setting в profile, override browser-detected. 8) Persisted timestamps в audit-log — UTC always; convert на read. 9) Tests: dates around DST transitions, year-boundaries, leap-seconds (rare but real). 10) ISO 8601 only on wire — never local-format strings on API. На fintech-интервью — TZ-bugs cost millions; emphasis on rigor.
